blind.description: A sculpted pedestal or brazier basin made from reddish-brown terracotta or weathered bronze. A wide, shallow circular basin on top is supported by several squatting, horned gargoyle-like devils or imps with their arms raised to hold the underside of the bowl. The figures rest upon a round cylindrical base decorated with raised flame motifs. The entire structure is solid, contiguous, and resting flat on the ground with no floating or broken elements.
blind.from_above: A simple hollow circular bowl or basin with a thick rounded rim and a darkened interior cavity.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the rim.
